## OptimBot vs CooperateBot — OUTCOME IS (D, C). NEARLY DONE.

OptimBot(k) source (verified eval):
rung3 = search k (plays opp self D) [ search k (plays self opp D) (const D) (const C) ] (const C)
rung2 = search k (plays opp self C) [ search k (plays self opp C) (const C) rung3 ] rung3
rung1(head)=search k (plays opp self C) [ search k (plays self opp D) (const D) rung2 ] rung2

vs CooperateBot: rung1 outer guard "CB plays C vs Optim" TRUE (provable). Descend into
rung1 THEN = search k (plays self opp D)="Optim plays D vs CB"=φ_D (const D) rung2.
KEY: φ_D IS PROVABLE via Löb (searchChain reading of rung1) → Optim plays D. OUTCOME (D,C).
(NOT (C,C): the exploit rung fires because φ_D is Löb-provable; consistency means C-rung
never reached since eval checks D first.)

### WHAT COMPILED (all verified via run_lean_proof):
1. eval D-path: given hOuter:=proofSearch k (plays CB Optim C)=true, hD:=proofSearch k
   (plays Optim CB D)=true, then play (fuel+6) OptimBot CB = some D. Proof:
   `show eval...; unfold OptimBot at hOuter hD ⊢; simp [eval,Prog.subst,Formula.subst,hOuter,hD]`
2. optim_loeb_premise_D (k)(hk:1≤k): Pf (300*Nat.log2 k+3000) (.impl (.box k φ_D) φ_D).
   Route: cheap box_1 of (plays CB Optim C) [AtomProvable 1 via PlaysProof.const cost c_leaf],
   boxMono 1→k, mp → box_k; searchChain reading of rung1 with
   L=[(k, plays self opp D, optim_rung2 k)], const=D, hme=rfl; simp only[searchGuards,
   implChain,List.foldr,Formula.subst,Prog.subst] at hchain; mp hchain box_k; Pf_mono to
   target; `have hlog1:Nat.log2 1=0:=by decide; simp only[Formula.size,Prog.size,numCost,
   OptimBot,CooperateBot,hlog1]; omega`. NOTE: must use CHEAP box (kIn=1 then boxMono) else
   boxIntro budget = k+... = O(k) breaks bound. Bound 300 log2k+3000 (100/200 too small).
3. optim_D_atom_size: (plays Optim CB D).size ≤ 20*Nat.log2 k+200 (10/100 too small).
4. optim_D_provable: ∃k₂,∀k>k₂,∃m,Pf m (plays Optim CB D). Uses pblt_engine (NOT
   pblt_engine_id — pm=300log2k+3000 exceeds its 100log2k+1000 bound). f=id,
   pm=fun k=>300 log2k+3000, k₁=max 1 Ksz, Ksz from linear_log2_add_le (8192*321)(8192*3208).
   hsz: `show 8192*(...)≤id k; simp only[id] at *; omega`.

optim_rung2 defined as `private def` = the else-branch literal (copy from OptimBot rung2).
